channel.title: The Mutapa Times — Daily Zimbabwe Weather + Tsumo
channel.description: Daily weather forecast for Zimbabwe's main cities plus the Tsumo yezuva (proverb of the day). One item per day, dedicated for the Mutapa Times weather autolist.

item.title: Zim weather 21 Nov: Harare drizzle · high 30° / low 19°
item.description: Harare: high 30°, low 19° (drizzle) · Bulawayo: high 34°, low 23° (light drizzle) · Mutare: high 30°, low 19° (foggy) · Gweru: high 31°, low 20° (light drizzle) · Masvingo: high 34°, low 22° (light drizzle) · Victoria Falls: high 35°, low 22° (heavy drizzle) Tsumo yezuva: Rina manyanga hariputirwi.
